title: Uniformity of interpretation.
bodyText: This chapter shall be so construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it.
bodyHtml: §831-6  Uniformity of interpretation.  This chapter shall be so construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it. [L 1969, c 250, pt of §1; HRS §716-6; ren L 1972, c 9, pt of §1]
